entry.title: Introducing The AzurPoly Dassault Rafale
entry.summary: Experience the first officially licensed Dassault Aviation Rafale C* for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024!Developed by AzurPoly in cooperation with JFEXP, this detailed rendition brings one of France’s most advanced aircraft to the simulator with a high level of care, immersion and functionality. Developed from the ground up over a period of more than two years, … Continued

entry.title: Famous Flyer 10: Boeing 707-320C Interview With Working Title
entry.summary: Earlier this week we released a revamped Famous Flyer 10: Boeing 707-320C for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, developed by Working Title and iniBuilds. To celebrate this launch, we recently asked Chris Burnett, one of the founders of Working Title, some questions to get a behind-the-scenes look at this new airliner!
